<a name="DecodeStrict"></a>
## func [DecodeStrict](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/b64/b64.go#L18>)

```go
func DecodeStrict(s string) ([]byte, error)
```

DecodeStrict decode Base64 canonical, alfabet dicek manual karena StdEncoding diam\-diam buang \\r dan \\n.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>

Input yang bukan Base64 canonical ditolak, termasuk newline di dalamnya.

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/brii26/release-signer/pkg/b64"
)

func main() {
	ok, _ := b64.DecodeStrict("Zm9v")
	fmt.Println(string(ok))
	_, err := b64.DecodeStrict("Zm9v\n")
	fmt.Println(err != nil)
}
```

#### Output

```
foo
true
```

</p>
</details>
